links.outcome: GPT-5 concordance with tumor-board recommendations versus GPT-4o in GI oncology cases
links.effect: GPT-5 achieved 85% concordance with tumor-board validation, identical to GPT-4o, contradicting claims of superiority.
links.quote: We evaluated GPT-5 against 100 gastrointestinal oncology cases with tumor-board validation and found identical 85% concordance to GPT-4o, contradicting superiority claims.

unlisted_practices: Mandatory accuracy disclosures and regulatory oversight for public AI health demonstrations
